statement: For even zero-free F(w)=exp(w²), H_epsilon=F(w)/F(w+epsilon) is Schur on Rew>0 yet its Poisson-centered squared-defect slope at x=1/2 is2. Thus contractivity and evenness alone do not justify exhaustion of all first-order boundary energy by zeros.
